data.title: 西连寺春菜 · 雾气浴室的毛巾轻挽
data.action: 坐在木质更衣长凳上，一手拢住身上的纯白大毛巾，另一手用干毛巾擦拭微湿短发
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level, soft misty atmosphere
data.lighting: 透过磨砂玻璃的暖黄壁灯在腾起的水雾中漫射
data.location: 沐浴后暖雾缭绕的日式浴室更衣间木质长凳
data.description: 刚沐浴完的更衣间里暖汽氤氲。春菜坐在光滑的杉木长凳上，身上紧紧裹着洁白的纯棉大毛巾。她一手稳稳拢住胸前的毛巾折口，一手拿着小干毛巾细细擦拭微湿的发梢，水汽模糊了四周镜面，双颊因热气泛起动人的红晕。
data.promptProse: Seated on a polished cedar bench in the steamy dressing room, Haruna steadies the folded white bath towel around her chest with one hand while drying her damp purple bangs with a small hand towel. Warm diffused light through frosted glass creates a soft glow in the rising steam.
data.animaCaption: One hand secures the large towel while the small towel dries her bangs.
